floors.title: Ground Floor Residential Unit
floors.description: Ideal for families preferring zero-stair access, senior family members, or quick daily movement. Features bright tiled rooms, clean bathroom facilities, and good ventilation.

floors.title: First Floor Premium Unit (Featured Floor)
floors.highlight: Flagship Living Space with Modular Kitchen & Chimney
floors.description: The standout unit of Hamid Residency. Outfitted with an immaculate modular kitchen featuring white/whitish gloss tile work and a sleek black chimney, contemporary tiled bathrooms, and large white-framed glass windows offering serene daylight.

floors.title: Upper Residential Unit
floors.description: Quiet, airy upper-floor living with unobstructed natural breeze, privacy, modern tiled interiors, and white-framed windows overlooking local neighborhood greenery.
